character: the regime's crates and pit props, cheap boards nailed in a hurry: they SNAP into combs of splinters and peel long slivers along the grain, fresh pale wood inside a grey-brown skin

strips.layout: column = variant v, row = pair p = ia * 4 + ib (ia, ib = the level index of the start / end vertex)

stages.grain: authored for horizontal grain; rotate 90 deg for a vertical-grain cell
stages.use: opaque overlay over the cell art at dmg/thr crossing 25 / 50 / 75 %; variant h32(x, y, 71) % 4; clip to the body

bites.grain: horizontal; rotate 90 deg on a vertical-grain cell
bites.use: one per bullet hit on wood, variant h32(x, y, 80 + salt) % 6; opaque, clipped to the body

fibres.use: a beam / pit prop cut across: draw row 0 at the upper piece's broken end, row 1 at the lower; the gap between is the hole

facets.#ff0000: top: the art one ramp step lighter
facets.#00ff00: front: the art as it is

chunks.use: as concrete: a removed cell gives 3-6 chunks cut from its own art, turned by 90s, settling on a 36 deg cone with a 1 px contact shadow

facets.#00ff00: the crate's painted face kept AS IT IS

slabs.use: as concrete slabs (holes of 3+ cells): boards leaning at the foot

behind: the level back plane two steps darker with a contact shadow (as concrete); a crate shows its own dark inside (#3a2a20) first
dust: no dust cloud: 3-6 slivers (chunks 0, 1, 6) thrown per hit, spinning, landing as floor scatter; sawdust = dust_puff_mat in #d1a769
